raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Sixty `silver_customers` rows (customers in the 01-04 batch) carry numeric region codes instead of names, and `upper()` cannot translate them. `raw_region_map` provides the code-to-name mapping (01 WEST, 02 EAST, 03 NORTH, 04 SOUTH), so a left join on it should normalize the region without changing the table's columns or row count.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(upper(m.region_name), upper(c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON c.region = m.region_code;"}}
